description: This is an abstract Java class implementing core functionalities for processing loan repayment transactions within a financial application. It provides common methods for handling various transaction types such as repayments, refunds, charge-offs, chargebacks, and overpayments, and defines abstract methods for specific payment processing strategies to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: This abstract class provides an implementation of common transaction processing logic for loan repayments, including handling different transaction types, overpayments, refunds, charge-offs, and chargebacks. It requires subclasses to define specific handling for early payments, on-time payments, and late payments, promoting a consistent yet customizable approach to repayment processing within the loan management system.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Checks if this processor accepts the given code or name string, case-insensitive, to identify the transaction processing method.

methods.name: reprocessLoanTransactions
methods.description: Main method to reprocess all loan transactions and schedules based on new disbursement date, transactions, installments, charges, and currency, updating owed amounts and handling various transaction adjustments.

methods.name: processLatestTransaction
methods.description: Processes a single latest transaction based on its type, updating components, handling overpayments, refunds, chargebacks, etc.

methods.name: handleRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Handles the processing of all repayment transactions for a schedule, returning unprocessed amount.

methods.name: isInterestFirstRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Indicates if this processor handles interest-first repayment schedule transactions. Default is false.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method to handle early ('in advance') payments for a specific installment.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method to handle on-time payments for a specific installment.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method to handle late payments for an installment.

methods.name: onLoanOverpayment
methods.description: Hook method called when the payment results in overall loan overpayment, default is empty implementation.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Abstract method to process refunds associated with installments.

methods.name: isTransactionInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date is before the installment due date, indicating an advance payment.

methods.name: isTransactionALateRepaymentOnInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date is after the installment due date, indicating late repayment.

methods.name: recalculateChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the transaction when a charge-off occurs, adjusting components for principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: reprocessChargebackTransactionRelation
methods.description: Reprocesses transaction relations related to chargebacks, linking new and old transactions.

methods.name: reprocessInstallments
methods.description: Reevaluates and updates the status of installments, particularly obligations and obligations met status, based on current transactions and waivers.

methods.name: isObligationsMetOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Checks if obligations are met on the disbursement date for an installment.

methods.name: isNotObligationsMet
methods.description: Determines if obligations are not met for an installment, i.e., unpaid or partially paid.

methods.name: addChargeOnlyRepaymentInstallmentIfRequired
methods.description: Adds a charge-only repayment installment if certain charges have specific due dates.

methods.name: getLatestLoanChargeWithSpecificDueDate
methods.description: Fetches the latest loan charge which has a specific due date.

methods.name: getInterestTillChargeOffForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the total interest accrued until the charge-off date for a loan.

methods.name: createMissingAccrualTransactionDuringChargeOffIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates an accrual transaction if interest is missing during a charge-off, ensuring proper financial accounting.

methods.name: handleWriteOff
methods.description: Processes a write-off transaction by adjusting outstanding principal, interest, and charges.

methods.name: handleChargeback
methods.description: Handles a chargeback transaction, typically involving reversal or correction of previous payments.

methods.name: handleChargeOff
methods.description: Handles the process of charging off outstanding loan amounts.

methods.name: handleCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund related to credit balances in the loan account.

methods.name: handleRefund
methods.description: Handles refund processing across installments and charges, reversing applicable components.

methods.name: undoChargesPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses or partially deletes paid charges, updating the related data structures accordingly.

methods.name: findEarliestUnpaidChargeFromUnOrderedSet
methods.description: Finds the earliest unpaid (or due) charge from a set, prioritizing based on due date.

methods.name: findLatestPaidChargeFromUnOrderedSet
methods.description: Finds the most recent paid or partially paid charge from a set, based on due date.

methods.name: updateChargesPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Applies payment towards unpaid charges, updating paid amounts and relations.

methods.name: getChargesPaymentFunction
methods.description: Returns a functional interface for handling charges payment or unpayment actions.

methods.name: createNewTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record, linking it to the original via relations, for cases like reversals.

methods.name: processCreditTransaction
methods.description: Processes a credit transaction, updating schedule components and handling overpayments.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Processes a transaction across installments, determining advance/late/on-time payments and updating schedule accordingly.
